assessment: In this revised manuscript, Noureen and collaborators benchmark five methods that are used in single-cell RNA sequencing data analyses, including single sample gene set enrichment analysis (ssGSEA), Gene Set Variation Analysis (GSVA), AUCell, Single Cell Signature Explorer (SCSE), and a newly developed method, Jointly Assessing Signature Mean and Inferring Enrichment (JASMINE). The authors test these in distinct cancer datasets and conclude that caution should be exercised when using bulk sample-based methods in single-cell data analyses, and cellular contexts should be taken into consideration. As a rapidly developing field in need of method benchmarking, we believe that this paper will be of great interest to the bioinformatics and single-cell data analysis communities.
